evals.prompt: I want to run a standalone Python script in Isaac Sim that loads a Franka arm, adds a cube, commands the arm to pick the cube up, and runs headless in a Docker container on an AWS G5. What's the minimal script boilerplate, what Docker image do I use, and what's the right controller for a pick?
evals.expected_output: Fetches python_scripting/manual_standalone_python.html for SimulationApp(CONFIG) boilerplate (import order, headless config), installation/install_container.html for nvcr.io/nvidia/isaac-sim tag + GPU flags, core_api_tutorials/tutorial_core_hello_robot.html + adding_manipulator.html for the Franka + cube setup, and either cumotion/tutorial_trajectory_generator.html or a manipulator controller page for the pick motion. Produces minimal Python outline. Cites HTML URLs.

evals.prompt: I imported my custom URDF but the joints are all spinning freely — no stiffness, no damping. Where do I configure joint drives for a URDF-imported robot in Isaac Sim?
evals.expected_output: Fetches robot_setup/ext_omni_importer_urdf.html. Extracts the URDF importer drive conversion (velocity/position drive) and how to tune stiffness/damping post-import via the USD ArticulationRootAPI and JointAPI. Mentions the importer flag that enables drives during import. Cites the HTML URL.

evals.prompt: I have an Isaac Lab-trained policy saved as TorchScript and I want to run it live in Isaac Sim with a Nova Carter robot and an RTX camera sensor — what's the API for loading the policy and wiring the camera output to the policy input?
evals.expected_output: Fetches robot_simulation/ext_isaacsim_robot_policy_example.html for loading a trained policy, robot_simulation/ext_isaacsim_sensors_rtx.html for RTX camera setup, and assets/usd_assets_robots.html for Nova Carter. Shows the observation construction pattern and the per-step policy.forward() call. Notes training questions route to the isaac-lab skill. Cites HTML URLs.
